newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Grenade "toy" kills three children in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: Grenade "toy" kills three children in Zaire.

text.p: Three children were killed in Zaire's capital Kinshasa on Saturday when a grenade they were playing with exploded, witnesses said. A fourth child escaped with slight injuries.

The incident happened in Kinshasa's Gombe district near the Kokolo military camp. "The child handling the grenade was the son of a soldier. The question is how or where he got the grenade," one witness said.
State radio put the toll at two dead children and one injured.
